title.narrative: JDPC Advocacy Capacity Strenghtening for the Influence of Legislative Processes

description.narrative:
The Catholic Bishops Conference of Nigeria (CBCN), over the decades has been developing effective framework for promoting integral human development in Nigeria in conformity with the social teachings of the universal Church, with particular regards to the promotion of social justice and the common good.
The Conference, through the Catholic Secretariat of Nigeria, through the Justice, Development and Peace/Caritas Nigeria of the Catholic Secretariat of Nigeria (CSN) has been carrying out activities in respect of the social responsibilities of the Church which include promoting dialogue with governments, parliaments, political parties and civil societies.
In order to be more relevant in the political arena, the Catholic Secretariat of Nigeria, in 2005, inaugurated a Think Tank (presently made up of 12 members) - a research, documentation and advocacy initiative with the particular objective to provide appropriate and effective framework and grounds, in terms of expert, professional and state-of-the-art data, for the Bishops Conference in its advocacy engagements with government and the civil society.
The intention of the project is to change the monopoly of the political class in legislative matters and make the Church more relevant and physically present in the country’s National Assembly through the presence of a Catholic Liaison Officer, a position that CAFOD shall be supporting given its strategic role if the objectives of the project is to be achieved. This will enhance the voice of the Church, as representative of the poor masses in the Legislative House; and change the exclusivity right of the political class to the promulgation of Laws for democratic and good Governance in the country.
Such imminet changes shall also be enhanced through advocacy capacity strengthening for the JDPC Coordinators with focus on the Principles of the Catholic Social Teachings (CST). The strategy is that the trained Coordinators with their newly acquired skills will be transmitting information/data generated from the communities and the parishes to the Liason Officer at the National Assembly, to support issues based advocacy.
